# California Prime Recovery

> > California Prime Recovery provides evidence-based addiction treatment and mental health services with comprehensive educational resources on substance abuse, mental health disorders, and recovery support.

Led by clinical experts including Charee Marquez (LMFT) and Karynne Witkin (M.A. I/O Psychology), California Prime Recovery offers treatment programs and educational content covering substance use disorders, mental health conditions, medication-assisted treatment, and insurance guidance for individuals seeking recovery in LA County and beyond.

## Key Topics

- Substance abuse treatment
- Mental health disorders
- Addiction recovery
- Opioid withdrawal and treatment
- Bipolar disorder
- Dissociative disorders
- Health anxiety and illness anxiety disorder
- Medication-assisted treatment (Vivitrol)
- Drug testing and detection
- Cannabis and THC effects
- Insurance coverage (in-network vs out-of-network)
- Clinical assessment tools (COWS Score)
- Serious mental illness
- Drug paraphernalia awareness
- Evidence-based therapeutic approaches

## Mental Health Treatment & Disorders

- [Types of Bipolar Disorder | Causes, Symptoms & Treatment Insights](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/understanding-bipolar-types-symptoms-and-treatment): Guide to bipolar disorder types, mood episodes, symptoms, and treatment
- [What Are Dissociative Disorders | Types, Symptoms, and Treatment](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/understanding-dissociative-disorder-symptoms-and-treatment): Explains dissociative disorders, trauma-related symptoms, and treatment
- [Serious Mental Illness: Understanding Causes & Treatment Options](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/serious-mental-illness): Covers serious mental illness causes, treatment, and support resources
- [What is Health Anxiety? 10 Common Symptoms](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/what-is-health-anxiety): Covers health anxiety symptoms and illness anxiety disorder treatment
- [Social Media Addiction: Causes & Effects of Digital Dependency](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/social-media-addiction): Covers social media addiction causes, mental health effects, and treatment

## Opioid & Substance Abuse Treatment

- [COWS Score: What It Is & How Opiate Withdrawal Is Measured](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/cows-score): Explains Clinical Opiate Withdrawal Scale for measuring opioid withdrawal
- [How Long Does Heroin Stay in Your System? | Comprehensive Guide](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/how-long-does-heroin-stay-in-your-system): Guide to heroin detection times, drug testing methods, and metabolism
- [Vivitrol Side Effects: Risks, Warnings, and Common Reactions](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/vivitrol-side-effects): Details Vivitrol side effects for opioid and alcohol use disorder treatment
- [Common Types of Drug Paraphernalia Explained](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/common-types-of-drug-paraphernalia): Identifies drug paraphernalia types, uses, and health risks for prevention

## Drug Risks & Safety Information

- [What is Pink Cocaine: Understanding the Risks and Effects](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/pink-cocaine): Explains pink cocaine synthetic drug risks, effects, and health dangers
- [Can You Get a Weed Hangover? | Effects & Recovery](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/can-you-get-a-weed-hangover): Explains weed hangover signs, THC aftereffects, and recovery tips
- [Can You Overdose on Ibuprofen? | Risks, Symptoms, and Treatment](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/can-you-overdose-on-ibuprofen): Explains ibuprofen overdose risks, NSAID symptoms, and treatment options
- [Promethazine Side Effects, Uses and Risks](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/promethazine-side-effects): Details promethazine antihistamine side effects, uses, and safety risks
- [How Long Does a Hangover Last? Understanding Symptoms and Relief](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/how-long-does-a-hangover-last-understanding-symptoms-and-relief): Covers hangover duration, alcohol processing, symptoms, and relief tips

## Insurance & Treatment Access

- [In Network vs Out of Network Insurance Explained](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/in-network-vs-out-of-network-insurance): Explains insurance network differences, costs, and provider access

## Optional

- [What is Cognitive Dissonance: A Deep Dive into the Human Mind](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/understanding-cognitive-dissonance): Deep dive into Festinger's cognitive dissonance theory and psychology
- [What Is Empty Nest Syndrome and Why It Happens](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/what-is-empty-nest-syndrome): Covers empty nest syndrome causes, signs, and coping strategies
- [Mental Health Emerges as a Leading New Year's Resolution, Survey Shows](https://californiaprimerecovery.com/mental-health-emerges-as-a-leading-new-years-resolution): Survey findings on mental health resolutions and SMART goal framework
